summary: Join our Creativity and Innovation Training Course to boost your creative skills. Learn to think outside the box and transform ideas into impactful solutions.
lede: Creative thinking and innovation give professionals a structured way to turn opportunities into concepts and tested solutions. Designed for people who improve services, lead change or assess new ideas, the course covers opportunity framing, concept generation and selection, and assumption testing through prototypes and experiments. Learners also practice evaluating ideas for desirability, feasibility and viability, then communicating evidence to support an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This creativity and innovation training suits professionals who shape opportunities, improve services, lead change, or evaluate new concepts. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need a practical process rather than specialist research or advanced technical design.
prerequisites: No formal qualification is required. You should bring a practical workplace challenge involving a product, service, process, customer experience, technology adoption, or organizational improvement. Basic familiarity with spreadsheets and collaborative digital tools is helpful, but coding and programming are not required. Advanced subjects such as AI-assisted ideation, portfolio governance, and Stage-Gate are taught at conceptual and operational application level, while Design Thinking, prototyping, assumption mapping, and experiment planning receive hands-on practice.
